# interactiondesign.nl · Dennis Jansen

> Dennis Jansen, UX researcher and service designer. This site holds his field observations and how he works. His UX lens is at proofbridge.nl: a text a person loads into their own AI chat as a connector.

## proofbridge.nl
- For agents: nothing open since 2026-11-24. The review by mail ended on that date.
- Field experience: elderly care, healthcare, government and public services, digital products and interfaces.
- [What is here, for agents (markdown)](https://proofbridge.nl/agents/index.md)
- [The same as JSON](https://proofbridge.nl/offer.json)

## What this site holds
- [Observations](https://interactiondesign.nl/index.md): nineteen cases where AI output, plans or data and the field part ways, each with its source.
- [How I work](https://interactiondesign.nl/setup/index.md): why, the gap, how I work, the door to the UX lens.
